Discover

"What if your summer address had a world-class resort on the lake, a real downtown worth exploring, boat-to-dinner restaurants right on the water, private airport access 20 to 30 minutes away — and summers that actually make you want to be outside?"

Most people settle for one or two of those things.
Coeur d'Alene delivers all of it.

The Lake

Your Dock.
Your Highway.

Lake Coeur d'Alene is 25 miles long, glacier-carved, and surrounded by mountains. But what sets it apart isn't just the scenery — it's what the lake lets you do.

Boat to dinner at Tony's on the Lake. Dock at the resort marina and walk into downtown. Pull up to Cedars floating restaurant right from the water. The lake isn't just a view — it's how you move through your summer.

Private lakefront estates with your own dock. Resort condos steps from the water. Historic downtown homes within walking distance of Sherman Avenue. There's a version of this life that fits exactly how you want to live it.
The Resort

World-Class.
Right on the Water.

The Coeur d'Alene Resort sits directly on the lake — a full luxury property that people fly in specifically to experience. Beverly's fine dining with panoramic lake views. Full-service spa. Lake cruises. Multiple waterfront restaurants. An infinity pool overlooking the water.

Dock your boat at the resort marina and you're in the middle of all of it. Golf, dine, spa — and walk into downtown from the same slip.

Most people vacation here. You'd own your summer here.

The world-famous floating green — one of the most photographed holes in golf.

The Coeur d'Alene Resort Golf Course
Downtown

A Real Downtown.
Real Energy.

Sherman Avenue runs straight to the water. Boutiques, wine bars, coffee shops, art galleries, live music, and restaurants that hold their own against any major city.

Walkable. Alive. Real character year round.

Not a tourist trap. Not a college town. Not restaurants on a highway with nothing around them.

A genuine downtown with energy — and the lake at the end of the street.

The Weather

Summers Worth
Showing Up For.

Highs in the 80s, occasionally 90s — but nothing that drives you indoors for four months. Four genuine seasons. Snow in winter, wildflowers in spring, golden falls, and summers that remind you why you bought here.

Your Scottsdale winters stay exactly as they are. You're just adding something extraordinary to the other half of the year.

Getting Here

You're Not Giving Up Access.
You're Gaining Everything Else.

✈

Commercial Travel

Spokane International Airport is 45 minutes away with direct connections to every major hub — Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Denver, Phoenix. Getting here and getting out is simple.

🛩

Private Aviation

If you fly out of Scottsdale Airport today, you already know the value of skipping the commercial terminal. Coeur d'Alene Airport has a full-service FBO — StanCraft Jet Center — with everything you'd expect for private aviation. Depending on where your home sits on the lake, you're 20 to 30 minutes from wheels down to your front door.
